title: Pick ONE deploy tree and converge the clones
summary: Decide the launch trunk and converge toward DEPLOY: port CANONICAL's matured layers (design, CLV, observability, failover, governance) into DEPLOY without inheriting CANONICAL's regressions (masked-success bug, unguarded DEV_FAKE_ADMIN). The unlock for the entire program.
payoff: Single source of truth; every later item lands once on the right clone instead of being built twice. Highest-leverage move in the program.

title: Close the 4 operational launch blockers
summary: Provision prod DB + one real ingestion (prod-probe green), fix cron-cadence-vs-freshness-gate, port migrate-in-build into DEPLOY vercel.json. Already specced as real-app P0 cards and audit top-10.
payoff: The hard launch gate; /api/ready stays 503 until green. Nothing ships without it.

title: Reconcile pricing + Stripe wiring to one source of truth
summary: Adopt CANONICAL pricing-phases.ts (Founding $14.99/$24.99 + annual + 4-var Stripe schema) across the launch tree before any Stripe price object is created. The two clones ship incompatible schemas today.
payoff: Customers are charged the intended price; unblocks annual plan, referral rewards, and the proof-gated ladder.

title: Port the matured design system into DEPLOY
summary: Bring surface/paper/data tokens + Tailwind scale + cinematic-entrance + Reveal/Atmosphere + dataviz kit into DEPLOY, replacing the ~1696 raw-neutral classes and the old gray-950 system.
payoff: What launches becomes the design that was matured (audit P0); foundation for all Wave 2 motion/UX work.

title: Port the inert observability + analytics scaffold into DEPLOY
summary: OTel/SigNoz init, PostHog provider, error sink + global-error.tsx. No-op without keys, so the port is safe-now; enabling each is a separate founder key decision.
payoff: Closes the launch-blind gap (today only console.* in Vercel logs); makes department-head metrics measurable.

title: Port the CLV pipeline into DEPLOY
summary: clv-capture + settle-sport CLV grading + Pick.clv* schema/migration. The single biggest accuracy/honesty asset that is canonical-only today.
payoff: The launch product can finally prove 'we beat the close' — the #1 sharp-accuracy trust signal and the spine of the pricing ladder.

title: Port the resilience toolkit into DEPLOY (inert)
summary: odds-failover, source-health circuit breaker, source-registry + assertIngestible legal guard. Inert plumbing safe-now; enabling a paid secondary is founder-gated (V26-301).
payoff: Removes the single-odds-provider SPOF foundation; one outage no longer blacks out the board once V26-301 enables it.

title: Port the governance layer into DEPLOY
summary: department-heads cockpit, compliance-program, monetization-levers, mission-control. The most differentiated compliance-forward governance is invisible in the shipping clone today.
payoff: Compliance-as-code + AI-run-company story is visible on the launch target; enables Wave 5 instrumentation.

title: Port DEV_FAKE_ADMIN production guard INTO CANONICAL
summary: The one regression flowing canonical-ward: CANONICAL's DEV_FAKE_ADMIN is not production-guarded; port DEPLOY's d26c306 hardening so a canonical prod deploy can't mint ADMIN+ELITE for every visitor.
payoff: Closes a P0 security hole on the non-trunk clone.

title: Fix the CI push-trigger SPOF
summary: DEPLOY's working branch matches no ci.yml push trigger, so guardrails can be bypassed by a direct push to launch HEAD. Add safety/* to triggers or rename the branch.
payoff: Guardrails (trust-gate, model-freeze, draft-only, brand-lint) actually run on the launch HEAD.

title: Publish the reliability curve as the public trust artifact
summary: Surface the calibration reliability curve / settled record publicly (results, not method). Already a data-mesh card.
payoff: The public, audited trust surface competitors lead with; on-trend with 2026 transparency-first AI-prop bar.

title: Write real currentEdgeIndex + GateDecision rows; partition slate by tier
summary: Today these are read-but-never-written. Write them and lead the slate with Elite/Strong. data-mesh SLATE-01.
payoff: Closes the named-but-empty metrics; gives the board a real quality gate and an auditable decision trail.

title: Stand up the walk-forward / frozen-holdout validation harness
summary: Walk-forward CV + frozen-season holdout + disjoint calibration split so accuracy claims are provable. data-mesh VAL-01.
payoff: Every pricing phase above FOUNDING and every accuracy claim becomes evidence-backed, not roadmap.

title: Activate shadow independent estimator + de-circularize the edge
summary: Add the first truly non-market fairProbability so the edge stops de-vigging the book's own consensus. Shadow-first is safe; flipping it into published confidence is a MODEL_VERSION step. data-mesh WIN-03.
payoff: The keystone accuracy unlock: a defensible, non-circular edge — the core of the proprietary-Rating mandate.

title: Fix the rating calibration defects
summary: null->0 percentile coercion bug, absolute Elite-band floor (no false Elite from relative rank — the Tua-not-Elite fix), empirical-Bayes/James-Stein shrinkage. data-mesh RAT-05/06/07.
payoff: The proprietary number stops minting false Elite; tier calibration matches reality.

title: Add Brier resolution decomposition to calibration
summary: Resolution is distinct from calibration; today GSE proves honesty but not edge. Decompose Brier into reliability + resolution.
payoff: Proves the model has discriminating power, not just honest probabilities.

title: Ambient 'Ask the Edge' across the funnel
summary: Route the existing reveal-less Model Court engine onto board / pick / rating / front-door, not just the one game room. Pure routing of an already-built engine.
payoff: Highest-leverage AI-native move; the engine is built but mounted in one place and absent from the launch funnel.

title: Citation chips + suggested follow-ups
summary: Perplexity-grade inspectability: render the already-enforced citations as clickable chips + offer follow-ups from a reveal-safe allow-list.
payoff: Brings answer inspectability to the 2026 bar without exposing any method.

title: Generative UI inside answers
summary: Render existing viz components (factor bars, calibration curve) inline in answers. Calibration curve safe-now; PRO factor bars founder-gated by tier.
payoff: Answers show their work visually; matches the AI-SDK/CopilotKit generative-UI bar while staying reveal-less.

title: Confidence + honesty chips + public fallback rate
summary: Display a confidence/grounding chip and a public successful-fallback/refusal rate. GSE is substance-ahead but doesn't DISPLAY its trust mechanisms.
payoff: Turns the strongest trust substance into a visible differentiator; instrumentable via PostHog/Amplitude.

title: Scroll choreography + editorial display moments
summary: Lenis + native CSS scroll-driven animations + a pinned 'Rating-assembly' scrollytelling that shows the number composes WITHOUT exposing weights. The award-tier gap is choreography, not more WebGL.
payoff: Closes the 2026 award gap (instructional motion) on a truthful, reveal-less foundation GSE already has.

title: Tokenize cold-open hex + illustrative generative hero
summary: cinematic-entrance.tsx hardcodes off-brand hex; tokenize to the softened palette. Reuse the shader machinery for a data-driven hero, labeled illustrative (live-data wiring is founder-gated).
payoff: Fixes off-brand colors on the most-watched first impression; a signature generative visual on the no-fabrication posture.

title: Personalization / adaptive layout primitive
summary: The one 2026 trend GSE has no foundation for: lens-memory -> adaptive nav/section-reorder/hero-swap. Build the preference+segmentation primitive first.
payoff: Real-time personalization is the headline 2026 web trend; net-new capability, not a duplicate of any built experience.

title: Wire a second odds provider + activate failover
summary: Enable odds-api.io as the secondary book against the now-ported failover plumbing. Enabling the paid secondary is founder/$$-gated.
payoff: Removes the live-spine SPOF; a single Odds-API outage no longer blacks out the entire board (keys already leaked once).

title: Read-only warehouse mirror
summary: BigQuery/dbt-style read-only mirror so backtests and the validation harness never touch prod Postgres. No warehouse/reverse-ETL MCP this session, so this is a build.
payoff: Safe, scalable analytics + backtesting substrate; the operational half of a 2026 intelligence stack.

title: Connect marketing MCPs -> live competitor war-room
summary: Wire Ahrefs / SimilarWeb / Supermetrics MCPs to make the static competitor war-room live. Read-only; keys founder-gated.
payoff: Turns a demo-fixture war-room into a real competitive-intel surface for the Growth head.

title: Activate nflverse injuries + EPA as scoring inputs
summary: Promote the canonical read-time nflverse/NGS/injury data into the score as estimators. Each wire-in is a founder-gated MODEL_VERSION step; sequence AFTER the independent estimator (V26-104).
payoff: Moves the engine past 100%-odds-derived toward the injury/usage/NGS blend competitors ship.

title: External uptime probe -> /api/ready
summary: Wire an external probe so the fail-closed truth contract actually pages on incident. Scripting is safe-now; binding is founder.
payoff: The truth contract becomes operationally useful instead of self-reported.

title: Port Beat the Model to DEPLOY + streak/identity/leaderboard spine
summary: BTM is canonical-only and localStorage-only today. Port it and add an account/streak/leaderboard layer that measures reasoning, not wagering (humane guardrails).
payoff: The launch tree gains its top-of-funnel daily-habit loop; Duolingo-class retention unlock on an ethical line. White space vs paid competitors.

title: Trigger dormant Novu daily digest + promote Cipher/Brief
summary: The pick-alert-* / gse-rating-mover workflows are defined but never triggered. Fire the daily digest and fold Cipher/Brief into the daily cadence. Push needs a Novu key.
payoff: >=1 push in first 90 days triples retention; activates a built-but-silent habit spine.

title: Klaviyo lifecycle email program
summary: Welcome / engagement-triggered upsell / winback tied to a dunning grace window. Currently absent entirely (the single biggest retention gap). Specs safe-now; connecting the key is founder-gated.
payoff: Closes the largest miss vs the 2026 retention+conversion bar; recovers dunning-driven involuntary churn.

title: Close the Dub referral loop + shareable season scorecard
summary: Dub builds links but nothing attributes/rewards a referral. Add attribution + a double-sided non-cash reward (+PRO days, never money) + a proof-led 'X-Y vs the Model' share artifact.
payoff: Working virality / CAC reduction even at K=0.3-0.5; the reward stays non-cash per the reins.

title: Add annual plan + escalator to the launch tree
summary: The launch tree has no annual option (2026 best practice: annual + ~8% escalator). Keep 3 tiers, ELITE anchoring PRO, and hold the proof-gated ladder as the anti-dark-pattern moat. Numbers/Stripe prices founder-gated.
payoff: Captures the annual-commitment revenue + churn protection the launch tree currently leaves on the table.

title: Instrument the engagement loop
summary: DAU/MAU, D1/D7/D30 by cohort, activation time via PostHog/Amplitude. Retention is unmeasurable today, so the 2026 benchmarks can't be tracked.
payoff: Makes the entire growth program measurable; precondition for personalization and lifecycle triggers.

title: Persist the approval-queue as an audit ledger
summary: Department-head / compliance approval decisions are render-time-only today. Persist who cleared which named regulated trigger.
payoff: Turns 'human-gated' into 'auditable'; mirrors and fills the GateDecision/audit-trail gap across the platform.

title: Instrument the department heads
summary: Wire Stripe->Growth, source-freshness->Data&Accuracy, Formbricks->Support, Novu->operator alerts so heads report measured status instead of FORECAST_ONLY/UNINSTRUMENTED.
payoff: The AI-run-company heads become real dashboards instead of modeled fixtures.

title: Langfuse on every Claude call + fix token-price undercount
summary: Add Langfuse cost+LLM-as-judge eval tracing; fix cost-monitor.ts hard-coded $3/$15 Sonnet rate that silently undercounts ~40-67% when a surface routes to Opus 4.8 ($5/$25).
payoff: Accurate AI COGS + per-call eval; removes a latent budget-blindness trap.

title: Port Airwave into DEPLOY (inert, legal-gated)
summary: Port the accountability-weighted SiriusXM pundit-accountability module inert and gated-off. Live capture needs legal sign-off; the Signal blend is founder + MODEL_VERSION. data-mesh SXM-01..07.
payoff: Stages the genuinely-net-new accountability-weighted Signal moat on the launch tree without enabling capture.

title: Tiered-autonomy ladder (AUTO/NOTIFY/APPROVE)
summary: Grounded in 2026 AgentOps research: non-regulated actions earn autonomy only via Langfuse-measured safety + founder sign-off; regulated triggers never leave APPROVE.
payoff: A safe path to more agent autonomy on the AI-run-company model without loosening any regulated gate.
